_doc: G1 floor proposal from round 0 (D1 rulings 3/5, PLAN v1.9, v1.16, v1.17, v1.20). Not binding until a decision adopts it; gates.json stays the provisional set. Accuracy floors sit at about the bf16 noise level the round-0 record shows; performance floors allow the LoFi/bf8 spread v1.9 describes. spread_ratio_p50 (>= 8 active rows) and spread_ratio_min/max (any active row) are the uniform-band checks; inactive_max_err is the inactive-collapse check. single_long gets a case-specific pcc floor (narrow band: q0.1-q0.9 half-width is 0.8 % of the series scale, see doc/optimize/iter_00/floors_g1.md).
